metadata.currency_basis: Uses Gold value_usd and retains each source currency; this script computes no conversion.
limitations: Review artifact over versioned public Gold; this is not an approved chat payload.
No raw filings or untracked bronze/silver/warehouse data are read.
Financial definitions, source precedence, USD normalization, entity scope, and coverage require owner review before activation.
metadata.period_rule: Years and semesters sum complete selected calendar quarters; native annual Gold rows are excluded from those sums.
metadata.source_selection: Lowest dim_source_priority.priority per metric/entity/quarter. Equal-rank records collapse only when normalized USD values match; mismatches are marked as conflicts.
